operating_contract.autonomy: Ordinary bounded repository implementation, normal CI/browser acceptance and roadmap-required no-write evidence work are standing-preapproved under AGENTS.md. Do not ask for routine Actions approval.
operating_contract.barbecue_scope: Conventional above-ground barbecue/grill only. Charcoal, gas, kettle, pellet and conventional smoker/barbecue apparatus are in scope. Underground/earth-oven, buried, ash/ember-buried, non-grill fire-pit/campfire and open-hearth techniques are excluded from V1.
operating_contract.barbecue_source_rule: Each leaf targets five independent admission-qualified references. Championship/competition discovery precedes specialist fallback; title wording alone never qualifies a source; never lower the source gate merely to reach five.
operating_contract.barbecue_storage: Durable state may retain references/IDs, creator/channel identity, qualification/provenance metadata, project-authored normalized observations, derived ranges/alternatives, safety state and compact programme state. No transcripts, copied recipe prose/instructions, images, downloaded video/audio or bulk raw API payload history.
operating_contract.barbecue_safety: Practitioner sources are technique evidence, not food-safety authority. Safety constraints require separate authoritative sources; poultry synthesis uses USDA/FSIS.
operating_contract.youtube: Generic YT-CUL remains retired/fail-closed for live Search. BARBECUE_TECHNIQUE_CORPUS_V1 is the sole registered scheduled Culinary YouTube acquisition work unit.
operating_contract.quota: Owner-verified Search limit remains 100/day. Barbecue pilot Search budget is 16 calls/quota-day, routine provider envelope 90, protected reserve at least five calls, one-second pacing. No paid quota, second project or quota multiplication.
operating_contract.public_runtime: Public runtime remains 85 recipes. Barbecue research/synthesis does not authorize public/runtime admission.
operating_contract.protected_storage: Protected production remains v8018 / 19,268 in exactly two D1 shards. Barbecue work does not authorize protected-body rewrite/export or D1 mutation.
operating_contract.knowledge_core: No Knowledge Core write from this app lane unless separately authorized.
operating_contract.billing_firewall: No paid infrastructure/API/corpus licensing or automatic billing expansion.
